V_mm.note: ellipsoid vertices; nxr runs on V_mm/1000 (metres)

H.note: signed mean curvature, +1/R on a sphere with outward normals; H = -1/2 (DX . n), DX the barycentric-area cotangent Laplacian of the positions (FaceOperators.mean_curvature)

J.note: the mixed current, [V x 3]: swirl + source + normal part

div_tan.note: divergence of the tangent flow (the default; Editor flowFieldCpu tangential=true, Rheome 4th argument 'tan'): div_curl(J, 'tan', .)

div3d.note: divergence of the full 3-D vector, no projection: div_curl(J, '3d', .)

div_curv.note: divergence of J_n n alone: div_curl(J, 'curv', .); div3d = div_tan + div_curv

curl_curv.note: curl of J_n n alone (0 in the continuum: mesh error); curl3d = curl_tan + curl_curv

layout: little-endian, row-major (C order); float64 or int32 .bin, no header

sources.identity: div3d = div_tan + div_curv, curl3d = curl_tan + curl_curv (to float rounding)

parameters.native_positions_unit: m (nxr); V_mm here is x1000, curl / div / H are per metre and need V_mm/1000
parameters.positions_cast: float32 then float64 (FaceOperators.__init__), as the Editor
parameters.current: tangent swirl about z + tangent source from the +x pole + normal part 1 + 0.5x + 0.3 sin(2 pi y) z, (x,y,z) unit-sphere coordinates
